mapper.select: select a.rela_id, a.competition_series_id, a.competition_track_config_id,a.enterprise_id, b.enterprise_name,a.copt_end_time, a.copt_start_time, a.spop_amount, a.cooperation_type, a.create_by, a.create_time, a.update_by, a.update_time, a.version, a.del_flag, a.user_id, a.org_id from competition_enterprise_rela a left join sponsoring_enterprise_info b on a.enterprise_id = b.enterprise_id where a.del_flag = '0' and a.competition_series_id = #{competitionSeriesId}
mapper.delete: update competition_enterprise_rela set del_flag = '1',update_time = now(),version = version+1 where competition_series_id = #{competitionSeriesId}
